question: Which of the following Gharanas does Padma Bhushan Kishori Amonkar belong to?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaipur-Atrauli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kishori Amonkar** was an inventive representative of the **Jaipur Gharana** and one of the greatest singers in the Indian classical vocal heritage.
 
• Indian classical dancer, choreographer, and teacher **Mrinalini Vikram Sarabhai.**
 
• Indian classical vocalist **Mogubai Kurdikar, **who lived from July 15, 1904, until February 10, 2001, was a well-known member of the** Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana.**
 
• **Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi**, often known as **MS Subbulakshmi,** was a **Tamil Nadu-born Indian Carnatic **singer. She was the first musician ever to receive India's highest civilian distinction, the **Bharat Ratna.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jaipur Gharana**

 
 
• **​**The **Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana **developed from the family of **Alladiya Khan**, who came from **Atrauli** and settled in **Jaipur**.
 
• **Alladiya Khan** (1855–1946), a pioneer of** Hindustani music**, developed the **Jaipur–Atrauli Gharana.**
 
• The raga repertory, vocal aesthetics, and technical prowess of the **Gharana **are well renowned.
 
• **Alladiya Khan, Mallikarjun Mansur, Kesarbhai Kerkar, Kishori Amonkar, Shruti Sadolikar, Padma Talwalkar**, and** Ashwini Bhide Deshpande** are the leading representatives of the **Jaipur Gharana.**
